Great food and lovely staff
Jul 2025 • Family
A lovely Japanese cafe next to railway street. We were in the area to se the train and stopped to have lunch. The staff were delightful, service was impeccable and food really nice! 
We ordered for the Yaki Soba , tempura , karaage chicken and gyozas. All the food was delicious. I would definitely recommend the restaurant for a good family, friends or solo meal. 
I even tried a berry yakult for the first time, it was delicious!
